track.title: Mahur: Hesar-e Mahur, Abol, Zanguleh, Naghmeh

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on A3 and dwells most on E in Hesar-e Mahur. Abol (0:08.4) introduces Gk, centred on E. The line peaks at Gk4 (373.3 Hz) at 0:42.7. It closes on D4, not the tonic (E4 → Gk4 → E4 → E4 → D4 → D4).
